name: course-directed
description: External course test programs. Edit this JSON without rebuilding the application. Signature indexes are relative to the layout signatureBase (course: 0x100).

tests.name: add 0 + 0
tests.description: Zero operands, with a non-zero marker so the test is observable.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0
    ori $t1, $zero, 0
    add $t2, $t0, $t1
    sw $t2, 256($zero)
    ori $t3, $zero, 1
    sw $t3, 260($zero)

tests.name: add 5 + 7
tests.description: Ordinary addition and a RAM signature.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 5
    ori $t1, $zero, 7
    add $t2, $t0, $t1
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: sub 9 - 4
tests.description: Ordinary subtraction.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 9
    ori $t1, $zero, 4
    sub $t2, $t0, $t1
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: add wraps modulo 2^32
tests.description: 0xFFFFFFFF + 1 must produce 0 without an overflow exception.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0xffff
    ori $t0, $t0, 0xffff
    ori $t1, $zero, 1
    add $t2, $t0, $t1
    sw $t2, 256($zero)
    sw $t1, 260($zero)

tests.name: sub underflows to 0xFFFFFFFF
tests.description: 0 - 1 must wrap, not trap.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0
    ori $t1, $zero, 1
    sub $t2, $t0, $t1
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: add crosses the sign bit
tests.description: 0x7FFFFFFF + 1 becomes 0x80000000, not an overflow exception.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0x7fff
    ori $t0, $t0, 0xffff
    ori $t1, $zero, 1
    add $t2, $t0, $t1
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: add rd = rs = rt
tests.description: Source and destination register are the same.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 21
    add $t0, $t0, $t0
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: add with $zero and write to $zero
tests.description: $zero reads as zero and ignores writes.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x1234
    add $t1, $t0, $zero
    sw $t1, 256($zero)
    add $zero, $t1, $t1
    sw $zero, 260($zero)

tests.name: add data-dependency chain
tests.description: Back-to-back dependent additions.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 1
    ori $t1, $zero, 2
    add $t2, $t0, $t1
    add $t3, $t2, $t1
    add $t4, $t3, $t2
    sw $t4, 256($zero)

tests.name: sub rs = rt
tests.description: Equal source registers produce zero; a marker proves execution.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 123
    sub $t1, $t0, $t0
    sw $t1, 256($zero)
    sw $t0, 260($zero)

tests.name: ori immediate 0
tests.description: ori with zero immediate leaves the low half unchanged; source high half is preserved.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0
    ori $t1, $zero, 0x1234
    ori $t2, $t0, 0x1234
    sw $t2, 256($zero)
    sw $t0, 260($zero)

tests.name: ori immediate 0xFFFF
tests.description: 0xFFFF is zero-extended, not sign-extended.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0xffff
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: ori preserves the high 16 bits
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0x1234
    ori $t0, $t0, 0x0
    ori $t0, $t0, 0xabcd
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: ori with rd = rs
tests.description: In-place OR-immediate.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x00ff
    ori $t0, $t0, 0x1100
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: ori -1 encodes 0xFFFF
tests.description: A negative literal is encoded as its 16-bit two's-complement pattern and zero-extended on read.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, -1
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: ori 0x8000 is not sign-extended
tests.description: The immediate high bit must not propagate into the upper 16 bits.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x8000
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: lui immediate 0
tests.description: LUI writes imm16 << 16 and the low half stays zero.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0x0000
    sw $t0, 256($zero)
    ori $t1, $zero, 1
    sw $t1, 260($zero)

tests.name: lui 0xFFFF then ori 0x8000
tests.description: The course-required LUI + ORI construction must produce 0xFFFF8000.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0xffff
    ori $t0, $t0, 0x8000
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: lui/ori 32-bit boundary values
tests.description: Construct 0x80000000, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0xFFFF0000 and 0x00008000 through LUI+ORI.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0x8000
    sw $t0, 256($zero)
    lui $t1, 0x7fff
    ori $t1, $t1, 0xffff
    sw $t1, 260($zero)
    lui $t2, 0xffff
    sw $t2, 264($zero)
    ori $t3, $zero, 0x8000
    sw $t3, 268($zero)

tests.name: lui/nop maintain PC+4
tests.description: LUI and NOP are non-control instructions; following ORIs must execute in order.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0xffff
    nop
    ori $t0, $t0, 1
    nop
    ori $t1, $zero, 0x55
    sw $t0, 256($zero)
    sw $t1, 260($zero)

tests.name: sw NextPC ignores its memory offset
tests.description: Nonzero and negative store offsets must only affect MemAddr, never the next PC.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 64
    ori $t1, $zero, 123
    sw $t1, -4($t0)
    ori $t2, $zero, 456
    sw $t2, 0($t0)
    lw $t3, -4($t0)
    sw $t3, 256($zero)
    ori $t4, $zero, 0x7f
    sw $t4, 260($zero)

tests.name: all non-control instructions use PC+4
tests.description: LUI, ORI, ADD, SUB, LW, SW and NOP are followed by visible writebacks in sequence.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0x1234
    ori $t0, $t0, 0x5678
    ori $t1, $zero, 4
    add $t2, $t0, $t1
    sub $t3, $t2, $t1
    sw $t3, 0x100($zero)
    lw $t4, 0x100($zero)
    nop
    add $t5, $t4, $t0
    sw $t5, 256($zero)
    ori $t6, $zero, 0x33
    sw $t6, 260($zero)

tests.name: lw/sw positive offsets do not branch
tests.description: A positive offset that would be a large branch displacement must only change MemAddr.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x200
    ori $t1, $zero, 0x1357
    sw $t1, 0x40($t0)
    ori $t2, $zero, 0x2468
    sw $t2, 0x80($t0)
    lw $t3, 0x40($t0)
    sw $t3, 256($zero)
    sw $t2, 260($zero)

tests.name: sw then lw
tests.description: Store 0x1234, load it back and store through a register.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x1234
    sw $t0, 512($zero)
    lw $t1, 512($zero)
    add $t2, $t1, $zero
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: multiple RAM addresses
tests.description: Two distinct words are written and read independently.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x11
    sw $t0, 512($zero)
    ori $t1, $zero, 0x22
    sw $t1, 516($zero)
    lw $t2, 512($zero)
    lw $t3, 516($zero)
    add $t4, $t2, $t3
    sw $t4, 256($zero)

tests.name: repeated overwrite
tests.description: The second store to the same address must win.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 1
    sw $t0, 512($zero)
    ori $t1, $zero, 2
    sw $t1, 512($zero)
    lw $t2, 512($zero)
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: negative offset with a non-zero base
tests.description: Base = M0+8, access at -8(base).
tests.assembly:
ori $t6, $zero, 520
    ori $t0, $zero, 0x55
    sw $t0, -8($t6)
    lw $t1, -8($t6)
    sw $t1, 256($zero)

tests.name: base register is not $zero
tests.description: Use $t6 = M0 as the base and offset 0.
tests.assembly:
ori $t6, $zero, 512
    ori $t0, $zero, 0x77
    sw $t0, 0($t6)
    lw $t1, 0($t6)
    sw $t1, 256($zero)

tests.name: lw reads a 32-bit value just stored
tests.description: Initialize the logical DM with sw, then load the full 0xCAFEBABE pattern back.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0xcafe
    ori $t0, $t0, 0xbabe
    sw $t0, 512($zero)
    lw $t1, 512($zero)
    sw $t1, 256($zero)

tests.name: store/load at the last RAM word
tests.description: Exercises the upper address boundary of the configured RAM.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x5a5a
    sw $t0, 12284($zero)
    lw $t1, 12284($zero)
    sw $t1, 256($zero)

tests.name: high-bit base plus offset wraps to a valid RAM word
tests.description: A base with bit 31 set and a positive offset must use 32-bit address arithmetic; base 0xFFFFF000 + 0x1000 = 0x00000000.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0xffff
    ori $t0, $t0, 0xf000
    ori $t1, $zero, 0x1357
    sw $t1, 0x1000($t0)
    lw $t2, 0x1000($t0)
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: stack frames with negative offsets
tests.description: Use $sp to save and restore three locals, then combine the restored values.
tests.assembly:
ori $sp, $zero, 576
    ori $t0, $zero, 0x1111
    sw $t0, -4($sp)
    ori $t1, $zero, 0x2222
    sw $t1, -8($sp)
    ori $t2, $zero, 3
    sw $t2, -12($sp)
    lw $t3, -4($sp)
    lw $t4, -8($sp)
    lw $t5, -12($sp)
    add $t6, $t3, $t4
    sub $t7, $t6, $t5
    sw $t7, 256($zero)

tests.name: store then immediately load and use
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0xabcd
    sw $t0, 512($zero)
    lw $t1, 512($zero)
    add $t2, $t1, $t1
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: lw result feeds an ALU operation
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x10
    sw $t0, 512($zero)
    lw $t1, 512($zero)
    ori $t2, $zero, 5
    add $t3, $t1, $t2
    sw $t3, 256($zero)

tests.name: beq taken
tests.description: Equal registers skip one instruction.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 3
    ori $t1, $zero, 3
    beq $t0, $t1, equal
    ori $t2, $zero, 0xbad
equal:
    ori $t2, $zero, 0x600d
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: beq not taken
tests.description: Unequal registers fall through.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 3
    ori $t1, $zero, 4
    beq $t0, $t1, skip
    ori $t2, $zero, 0x1111
    sw $t2, 256($zero)
skip:
    sw $t2, 260($zero)

tests.name: beq with offset 0
tests.description: Target is PC+4, the same address as fall-through.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 1
    ori $t1, $zero, 1
    beq $t0, $t1, next
next:
    ori $t2, $zero, 0x2222
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: beq with a positive offset
tests.description: Skip a store and a marker instruction.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 1
    ori $t1, $zero, 1
    beq $t0, $t1, forward
    ori $t2, $zero, 0xbad
    sw $t2, 260($zero)
forward:
    ori $t2, $zero, 0x3333
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: beq backward loop
tests.description: Count 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 with a backward branch and an unconditional beq.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 3
    ori $t1, $zero, 0
loop:
    add $t1, $t1, $t0
    ori $t2, $zero, 1
    sub $t0, $t0, $t2
    beq $t0, $zero, done
    beq $zero, $zero, loop
done:
    sw $t1, 256($zero)

tests.name: consecutive beq instructions
tests.description: Two taken branches in a row.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 1
    ori $t1, $zero, 1
    beq $t0, $t1, one
    ori $t2, $zero, 0xbad
one:
    beq $t0, $t1, two
    ori $t2, $zero, 0xbad
two:
    sw $t0, 256($zero)
    sw $t1, 260($zero)

tests.name: beq not taken, then dependent add
tests.description: 5 + 2 = 7 on the fall-through path.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 5
    ori $t1, $zero, 0
    beq $t0, $t1, skip
    ori $t2, $zero, 2
    add $t3, $t0, $t2
    sw $t3, 256($zero)
skip:

tests.name: beq comparing $zero with itself
tests.description: $zero == $zero must always be true.
tests.assembly:
beq $zero, $zero, eq
    ori $t0, $zero, 0xbad
eq:
    ori $t0, $zero, 0x4444
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: two negative values are equal
tests.description: 0xFFFFFFFF == 0xFFFFFFFF must take the branch; comparison is on 32-bit patterns.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0xffff
    ori $t0, $t0, 0xffff
    lui $t1, 0xffff
    ori $t1, $t1, 0xffff
    beq $t0, $t1, same
    ori $t2, $zero, 0xbad
same:
    ori $t2, $zero, 0x7777
    sw $t2, 256($zero)

tests.name: negative vs zero is not equal
tests.description: 0xFFFFFFFF != 0 must fall through and use the fall-through value.
tests.assembly:
lui $t0, 0xffff
    ori $t0, $t0, 0xffff
    ori $t1, $zero, 0
    beq $t0, $t1, bad
    ori $t2, $zero, 0x2468
    sw $t2, 256($zero)
bad:
    sw $zero, 260($zero)

tests.name: positive vs negative is not equal
tests.description: 1 != 0x80000000 even though both fit in 32 bits with different sign.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 1
    lui $t1, 0x8000
    ori $t1, $t1, 0x0
    beq $t0, $t1, bad
    ori $t2, $zero, 0x1357
    sw $t2, 256($zero)
bad:
    sw $zero, 260($zero)

tests.name: beq over a long forward displacement
tests.description: A positive branch offset skips eight distinct writebacks.
tests.assembly:
beq $zero, $zero, target
    ori $t0, $zero, 1
    ori $t0, $zero, 2
    ori $t0, $zero, 3
    ori $t0, $zero, 4
    ori $t0, $zero, 5
    ori $t0, $zero, 6
    ori $t0, $zero, 7
    ori $t0, $zero, 8
target:
    ori $t0, $zero, 0x55
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: j skips the next instruction
tests.description: The word after J must not execute; the target instruction must.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 1
    j target
    ori $t0, $zero, 0xbad
target:
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: j drives a backward countdown loop
tests.description: J and beq together implement a loop without jal/jr.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 3
    ori $t1, $zero, 0
loop:
    add $t1, $t1, $t0
    ori $t2, $zero, 1
    sub $t0, $t0, $t2
    beq $t0, $zero, done
    j loop
done:
    sw $t1, 256($zero)

tests.name: j target within the low text region
tests.description: A jump over several instructions must preserve the PC high nibble.
tests.assembly:
ori $t0, $zero, 0x10
    j end
    ori $t0, $zero, 0x11
    ori $t0, $zero, 0x12
    ori $t0, $zero, 0x13
end:
    sw $t0, 256($zero)

tests.name: mixed program using all seven instructions
tests.description: ori/ori/add/sub/sll/sw/lw/beq in one program; result 28.
